Baseline note for the 2026-10-09 re-baseline: own_units is carried at the historical 82 + declared scope below. The 21 prefix_only names that left the measured set are not lost -- they are satisfied by the source rewrite recorded under 'rewrites' (see tools/fpc_uses_rewrite.py; the ratchet verifies each one is off the FPC path rather than accepting the drop on trust).

Vcl.ExtDlgs.why: TOpenTextFileDialog/TSaveTextFileDialog are new code (Delphi builds them over IFileDialogCustomize, which LCL's TOpenDialog does not expose), and the rest of the unit is type aliases onto the LCL's own ExtDlgs.

Vcl.VirtualImage.why: Sprint F3-6's TSynRCSyn mechanism: the Delphi tree keeps the unit name and the FPC search path supplies the implementation. It must be a TYPE ALIAS, not a subclass -- a subclass makes DFM streaming a type error, measured by compiling both shapes.

devFileMonitor.why: main.lfm streams `object FileMonitor: TdevFileMonitor` and MainUi.pas uses the unit; the vendored Delphi control is TWinControl-based with {$IFDEF WIN32} guards FPC 64-bit never enters, so the identical class is ported to the FPC tree with the unit name preserved.

devMonitorThread.why: dependency of devFileMonitor; the port swaps FindFirstChangeNotification for the W form (FPC win64 has no implicit ANSI API) and casts the TEvent handle into THandle.

devMonitorTypes.why: shared types for the file monitor; only the unit guards needed the WINDOWS swap.

devShortcuts.why: main.lfm streams `object Shortcuts: TdevShortcuts`; needs LCLProc for ShortCutToText/TextToShortCut, which live in Delphi's Menus.

devShortcutsEditorForm.why: the modal editor form of devShortcuts (its .dfm shipped as devShortcutsEditorForm.dfm; ported to .lfm with the Delphi-only PixelsPerInch/TextHeight/OldCreateOrder dropped, and the Vcl.Themes style call replaced by clWindow).
